command:
cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set -e && rm -f /tmp/perf-smoke.json /tmp/baseline.jsonl && \
  echo '=== run perf harness ===' && \
  cargo run -p perf --quiet -- --duration 1 --output /tmp/perf-smoke.json 2>&1 | tail -3 && \
  echo '=== archive run 1 ===' && \
  node scripts/perf-baseline-archive.mjs /tmp/perf-smoke.json --history /tmp/baseline.jsonl && \
  echo '=== archive run 2 (test append) ===' && \
  node scripts/perf-baseline-archive.mjs /tmp/perf-smoke.json --history /tmp/baseline.jsonl && \
  echo '=== history file ===' && \
  wc -l /tmp/baseline.jsonl && \
  echo '=== compare with empty history (no file) ===' && \
  node scripts/perf-baseline-compare.mjs /tmp/perf-smoke.json --history /tmp/baseline-missing.jsonl --window 14 && \
  echo '=== compare with 2-entry history ===' && \
  node scripts/perf-baseline-compare.mjs /tmp/perf-smoke.json --history /tmp/baseline.jsonl --window 14
